hebrewText: אֵי זֶ֣ה הַ֭/דֶּרֶךְ יֵחָ֣לֶק א֑וֹר יָפֵ֖ץ קָדִ֣ים עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ

tokens.kjv: how, what, whence, where, whether, which (way).

tokens.bdb: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
tokens.kjv: he, [idiom] hence, [idiom] here, it(-self), [idiom] now, [idiom] of him, the one...the other, [idiom] than the other, ([idiom] out of) the (self) same, such (a one) that, these, this (hath, man), on this side...on that side, [idiom] thus, very, which. Compare H2063 (זֹאת), H2090 (זֹה), H2097 (זוֹ), H2098 (זוּ).

tokens.bdb: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
tokens.kjv: along, away, because of, [phrase] by, conversation, custom, (east-) ward, journey, manner, passenger, through, toward, (high-) (path-) way(-side), whither(-soever).

tokens.bdb: to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate
tokens.kjv: deal, distribute, divide, flatter, give, (have, im-) part(-ner), take away a portion, receive, separate self, (be) smooth(-er).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be smooth ; by implication  to apportion or separate
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be smooth ; by implication  to apportion or separate
tokens.explanation: to be smooth ; by implication  to apportion or separate
tokens.explanationEn: to be smooth ; by implication  to apportion or separate

tokens.bdb: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
tokens.kjv: bright, clear, [phrase] day, light (-ning), morning, sun.

tokens.bdb: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse)
tokens.kjv: break (dash, shake) in (to) pieces, cast (abroad), disperse (selves), drive, retire, scatter (abroad), spread abroad.

tokens.bdb: the fore or front part; hence (by orientation) the East (often adverbially, eastward, for brevity the east wind)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: the fore or front part; hence  the East (often adverbially
tokens.enLiteralWord: the fore or front part; hence  the East (often adverbially
tokens.explanation: the fore or front part; hence  the East (often adverbially
tokens.explanationEn: the fore or front part; hence  the East (often adverbially

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
